answer.evidence: The main gate and pillars are presented as flat south-facing elevations. The light areas atop the pillars are cap/facade bands rather than a clearly foreshortened top surface of the main gate body, and the central lintel has no substantial visible top plane.

answer.main_body: brick gate pillars with a central iron double gate
